summary: Instead of setting the language per file, add a files.associations block to the VS Code workspace settings.json (Command Palette > Open Workspace Settings (JSON)) mapping glob patterns such as *plays.yml to ansible and *init.yml to yaml.
questions: How do I make VS Code always treat my playbooks as Ansible files?
How do I add persistent file association for the Ansible language?

answer_card.title: Persist Ansible file association in VS Code
answer_card.answer_md:
Open *View > Command Palette > Open Workspace Settings (JSON)* and add:

```json
"files.associations": {
  "*plays.yml": "ansible",
  "*init.yml": "yaml"
}
```
